protocol.watchdog_fault: After normal resume, drop one diagnostic reply before the page handler, then explicitly invoke its captured 30000ms timeout callback. This checks the actual failure transition, not elapsed timeout performance.
protocol.limits: One bounded live browser episode. Global full-state arithmetic and telemetry parity are independently checked by the companion worker assay. No equilibrium uniqueness, biological vision, navigation or learning claim from this viewer.
